claim_text: The September 13, 2022 Farah superseding indictment, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57) paras 18 and 43, alleges that Empire Cuisine and Market received more than $28 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately May 2020 and January 2022, as a site and meal vendor under Feeding Our Future and Sponsor A. Face language is received (amount_paid), not amount_billed and not proven_loss. This is a subset of the $40 million Empire-group figure and must not be added to that $40 million, to the Bock $250 million headline, to HSS, or to the Mohamed $12 million.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, Empire Cuisine and Market received more than $28 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately May 2020 and January 2022.
